user.title: Aseko Display RS485
user.description: Listen for a Waveshare (or similar) TCP bridge on the ASIN Display RS485 bus. Use a free port (default 47525) so it does not clash with Aseko Local on 47524.

data_description.port: Must match the bridge destination port.
data_description.allowed_host: LAN IP of the RS485 bridge. Leave empty only if you cannot use an allowlist.
